description: 한국공항공사_전국공항 시간대별 탑승승객 수 조회_GW [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 전국공항 시간대별 탑승승객 수 조회 데이터는 한국공항공사가 제공하는 공공데이터로, 김포·김해·제주 등 주요 공항을 포함한 전국 15개 공항의 일별·시간대별 탑승객 집계 정보를 담고. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 김포공항 탑승승객, 김포공항 승객 수, 김해공항 승객 수, 제주공항 승객 수, 전국공항 혼잡도. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
